findings.title: OS Command Injection
findings.trigger: An attacker could supply a filename containing shell metacharacters, leading to command injection.
findings.assumptions: The filename parameter is directly used in the open function without any validation or sanitization. The environment where this code runs allows shell metacharacters in filenames.

findings.title: Improper Neutralization of Special Elements used in an OS Command ('OS Command Injection')
findings.trigger: If the message contains special shell characters and is logged to a file that is later processed by a shell, it could lead to command injection.
findings.assumptions: The message parameter is logged to a file and this file might be executed by a shell at some point. The code does not sanitize the message before logging it.
